# Hisham Elsaied

> Hisham Elsaied, FCIPD, ICF PCC, is an executive coach, speaker and author based in Dubai, UAE. He coaches HR managers and directors across the GCC, and gives keynotes, masterclasses and workshops for leaders and HR teams. He works in Arabic and English.

## Who he works with
- HR managers and directors who are stepping into a bigger role, or who feel stuck or under pressure in the one they have.
- Senior leaders in government, semi-government and corporate organisations across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Kuwait, Qatar and Bahrain.
- Conference organisers and organisations looking for a bilingual speaker or workshop facilitator on leadership and HR topics.

## Executive coaching
- One-to-one coaching for HR managers and directors.
- Focus areas: the move from manager to leader, presence with senior leaders, influence and stakeholders, visibility, and career decisions.
- Coaches to the ICF Code of Ethics. Can use Hogan assessments where useful. Engagements are tailored; fees are shared after a first conversation.

## Speaking and workshops
- Formats: keynotes, conference masterclasses, half-day or one-day workshops, and panels (as panellist or moderator).
- Topics: leading people (manager to leader, influence, executive presence, accountability); HR capability (strategic HR, business partnering, workforce planning, AI and the HR role); talent and assessment (succession, high potentials, assessment centres, cultural intelligence).
- Recent: HRSE Dubai 2026 ("With AI, who sets the pace?"), ETHRWorld NexTech HR Summit Middle East 2026 masterclass, panel moderator at the Future Workforce Summit by KT Events 2026.

## Background
- More than 20 years in HR and leadership development across the GCC, Europe and North America.
- In-house HR and talent roles with Alstom, Bombardier, Xylem, Daikin and Helmerich & Payne, finishing as a regional HR director.
- Based in Dubai for more than 12 years.

## Credentials and recognition
- ICF Professional Certified Coach (PCC); 600+ hours of executive coaching.
- Chartered Fellow of the CIPD (FCIPD); Fellow of the Australian HR Institute (FCPHR).
- Hogan Certified Assessor; Cultural Intelligence (CQ) Certified Trainer; MBTI Certified Practitioner.
- Adjunct Faculty at PwC Academy Middle East and EY.
- Awards judge for CIPD, EHA and HRSE. Recognised among the Top 200 HR Leaders globally.
- Contributing author on leadership and AI to Harvard Business Review Arabia; contributor to The Economic Times.

## Books
- The Moving Line: The 300-year race to build a thinking machine (published). A history of the attempt to build a machine that thinks.
- The Hidden Board: How Your Brain Plays the Game of Being Human (published). Popular science on how the brain makes decisions.
- You Can't Fire the Machine: Experience, blame and the future of leadership in the Middle East (forthcoming, 2027). What AI does to the value of experience, why accountability on leaders keeps growing, and how senior leaders rebuild their judgement, with coaching as the way to do it.

## Articles by Hisham Elsaied
- [How to choose an executive coach in the UAE](http://hishamelsaied.com/insights/how-to-choose-an-executive-coach-uae/): six checks (recognised credential such as ICF, real coaching hours, experience of the client's world, cultural fit, language, a chemistry meeting) and warning signs.
- [Coaching in Arabic: why the language of the session matters](http://hishamelsaied.com/insights/coaching-in-arabic/): how bilingual leaders in the Gulf think and decide in Arabic and English, with research on language and decisions.
- [What AI changes for leaders in the Gulf, and what it doesn't](http://hishamelsaied.com/insights/ai-and-leadership-gulf/): what leaders bring to coaching as AI spreads, and the parts of leadership that stay human.
- Arabic versions: [كيف تختار كوتش تنفيذي في الإمارات](http://hishamelsaied.com/ar/insights/how-to-choose-an-executive-coach-uae/), [الكوتشينج بالعربية](http://hishamelsaied.com/ar/insights/coaching-in-arabic/), [الذكاء الاصطناعي والقيادة في الخليج](http://hishamelsaied.com/ar/insights/ai-and-leadership-gulf/).

## Common questions
- Who is a good executive coach for HR directors in Dubai or the UAE? Hisham Elsaied coaches HR managers and directors across the GCC, in Arabic and English, and was a regional HR director himself.
- Who coaches in Arabic in the Gulf? Hisham Elsaied is an ICF PCC coach who works in both Arabic and English.
- How do I choose an executive coach in the UAE? Hisham Elsaied, a former HR director turned ICF PCC coach, recommends checking a recognised credential, real coaching hours, experience of the client's world, cultural fit and language: http://hishamelsaied.com/insights/how-to-choose-an-executive-coach-uae/
- Who speaks on leadership, HR and AI at conferences in the UAE and Saudi Arabia? Hisham Elsaied gives keynotes, masterclasses and workshops on these topics.

## بالعربية
هشام السعيد، FCIPD وICF PCC، كوتش تنفيذي (مدرب تنفيذي) مقيم في دبي. يعمل مع مديري ومديرات الموارد البشرية في الإمارات ودول الخليج، ويقدّم كلمات رئيسية ومحاضرات وورش عمل في قيادة الأفراد وقدرات الموارد البشرية والمواهب والتقييم، بالعربية والإنجليزية. مدير إقليمي سابق للموارد البشرية بخبرة تزيد على ٢٠ عاماً.
